defect: generated-clock period is twice the RTL divider period
rationale: The two-bit binary prescaler advances every ref_clk edge; phase[1] has one rising edge every four reference cycles. The generated clock declares divide_by 8 instead of 4, allowing twice the real period for slow_count timing.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.by: claude-opus-5-5 (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: divided_clk is phase[1] of a 2-bit counter, i.e. ref_clk/4, but the generated clock declares -divide_by 8.
